activity_places_supported_relations_chec.name: activity_places_supported_relations_check
activity_places_supported_relations_chec.value:
"activity_places"."supported_relations" <@ ARRAY['reached_peak', 'reached_saddle', 'crossed_pass', 'visited_pass', 'arrived_at_hut']::text[]
    AND cardinality("activity_places"."supported_relations") = (CASE WHEN 'reached_peak' = ANY("activity_places"."supported_relations") THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN 'reached_saddle' = ANY("activity_places"."supported_relations") THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN 'crossed_pass' = ANY("activity_places"."supported_relations") THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN 'visited_pass' = ANY("activity_places"."supported_relations") THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN 'arrived_at_hut' = ANY("activity_places"."supported_relations") THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    AND (cardinality("activity_places"."supported_relations") = 0 OR (array_ndims("activity_places"."supported_relations") = 1 AND array_lower("activity_places"."supported_relations", 1) = 1))

activity_places_encounters_check.name: activity_places_encounters_check
activity_places_encounters_check.value:
CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("activity_places"."encounters") = 'array'
        THEN jsonb_array_length("activity_places"."encounters") > 0 ELSE false END

places_kinds_check.name: places_kinds_check
places_kinds_check.value:
"places"."kinds" <@ ARRAY['peak', 'pass', 'hut']::text[]
    AND cardinality("places"."kinds") = (CASE WHEN 'peak' = ANY("places"."kinds") THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN 'pass' = ANY("places"."kinds") THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN 'hut' = ANY("places"."kinds") THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    AND (cardinality("places"."kinds") = 0 OR (array_ndims("places"."kinds") = 1 AND array_lower("places"."kinds", 1) = 1))
    AND cardinality("places"."kinds") > 0

places_subtypes_check.name: places_subtypes_check
places_subtypes_check.value:
"places"."subtypes" <@ ARRAY['peak', 'natural_saddle', 'road_trail_pass', 'alpine_hut', 'wilderness_hut']::text[]
    AND cardinality("places"."subtypes") = (CASE WHEN 'peak' = ANY("places"."subtypes") THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN 'natural_saddle' = ANY("places"."subtypes") THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN 'road_trail_pass' = ANY("places"."subtypes") THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN 'alpine_hut' = ANY("places"."subtypes") THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN 'wilderness_hut' = ANY("places"."subtypes") THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    AND (cardinality("places"."subtypes") = 0 OR (array_ndims("places"."subtypes") = 1 AND array_lower("places"."subtypes", 1) = 1))
    AND cardinality("places"."subtypes") > 0

places_kind_subtype_check.name: places_kind_subtype_check
places_kind_subtype_check.value:
('peak' = ANY("places"."kinds")) = ('peak' = ANY("places"."subtypes"))
        AND ('pass' = ANY("places"."kinds")) = ("places"."subtypes" && ARRAY['natural_saddle', 'road_trail_pass']::text[])
        AND ('hut' = ANY("places"."kinds")) = ("places"."subtypes" && ARRAY['alpine_hut', 'wilderness_hut']::text[])

places_location_check.name: places_location_check
places_location_check.value:
NOT ST_IsEmpty("places"."location"::geometry)
        AND ST_IsValid("places"."location"::geometry)
        AND ST_X("places"."location"::geometry) BETWEEN -180 AND 180
        AND ST_Y("places"."location"::geometry) BETWEEN -90 AND 90

places_terrain_check.name: places_terrain_check
places_terrain_check.value:
("places"."peak_prominence_m" IS NULL) = ("places"."peak_prominence_capped" IS NULL)
        AND ("places"."pass_amp_m" IS NULL OR ('pass' = ANY("places"."kinds") AND "places"."pass_amp_m" >= 0 AND "places"."pass_amp_m" < 'Infinity'::real))
        AND ("places"."peak_prominence_m" IS NULL OR ('peak' = ANY("places"."kinds") AND "places"."peak_prominence_m" >= 0 AND "places"."peak_prominence_m" < 'Infinity'::real))
        AND ("places"."dem_elevation_m" IS NULL OR ("places"."dem_elevation_m" > '-Infinity'::real AND "places"."dem_elevation_m" < 'Infinity'::real))

places_point_derivation_check.name: places_point_derivation_check
places_point_derivation_check.value:
("places"."osm_type" = 'node' AND "places"."point_derivation" = 'osm_node')
        OR ("places"."osm_type" IN ('way', 'relation')
          AND "places"."point_derivation" = 'validated_polygon_interior'
          AND 'hut' = ANY("places"."kinds"))
